records.title: Supplied conversation and project handoff
records.claim_supported: User authorized evidence-governed development and continuation; earlier assistant assessments are proposals, not facts.
records.limitations: Earlier conversation omitted; not a verbatim transcript; authorization does not establish efficacy.

records.title: PMBOK Guide, Eighth Edition
records.claim_supported: PMI identifies edition eight and value delivery, adaptability, accountability and tailoring.
records.limitations: Public publisher overview inspected; book not read.

records.title: ISO 9001:2026
records.claim_supported: ISO catalogue lists edition six as published and the 2015 edition as withdrawn.
records.limitations: Catalogue only; no licensed clause-level audit or conformity claim.

records.title: ISO 9241-210:2019
records.claim_supported: Human-centred design across the interactive-system lifecycle; catalogue confirms current edition.
records.limitations: Abstract/catalogue only; detailed methods and full standard not reviewed.

records.title: WCAG 2.2
records.claim_supported: Accessibility success criteria and conformance levels provide a testable web baseline.
records.limitations: TVM conformance not evaluated. Version status must be refreshed at release.

records.title: ISO 31000:2018
records.claim_supported: Catalogue lists the risk-management guideline as published with replacement under development.
records.limitations: No clause-level audit; monitoring dates are project choices.

records.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
records.claim_supported: Catalogue identifies the information-security management standard and a 2024 amendment.
records.limitations: Public catalogue only; implementation is risk-based guidance, not certified conformity.

records.title: NIST SP 800-218, SSDF 1.1
records.claim_supported: Final publication recommends integrating secure development practices into the SDLC.
records.limitations: Detailed control mapping still needed; SSDF is not an application penetration test.

records.title: NIST SP 800-218r1, SSDF 1.2 draft
records.claim_supported: NIST publication listing identifies SSDF 1.2 as draft, distinct from final 1.1.
records.limitations: Monitor; do not treat the draft as normative.

records.title: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0
records.claim_supported: OWASP identifies stable 5.0.0 and versioned testable application-security requirements.
records.limitations: TVM control selection and verification remain open; no ASVS compliance claim.

records.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
records.claim_supported: Catalogue describes management of AI systems and responsible lifecycle governance.
records.limitations: Public overview only; developer AI use and product AI are separate inventories.

records.title: NIST AI RMF 1.0
records.claim_supported: GOVERN includes documented responsibilities, risk processes and periodic reviews.
records.limitations: Selected relevant sections reviewed; does not establish TVM effectiveness.

records.title: NIST Generative AI Profile, AI 600-1
records.claim_supported: Addresses confabulation and source verification, including MS-2.5-003.
records.limitations: Selected sections reviewed; controls need adaptation to development workflows.

records.title: Hevner, March, Park and Ram: Design Science in Information Systems Research
records.claim_supported: Design science builds and applies artifacts to develop understanding of problems and solutions.
records.limitations: Publisher abstract only; TVM-specific utility is untested.

records.title: Skivington et al.: MRC complex-intervention framework
records.claim_supported: Primary abstract/summary sections address context, programme theory, stakeholder perspectives, key uncertainties and iterative refinement, rather than efficacy alone.
records.limitations: Primary article sections read via PMC using urllib after browser retrieval was blocked; not an exhaustive critical review. Health/social-policy transfer to executive facilitation is provisional.

records.title: Rousseau: Is There Such a Thing as Evidence-Based Management?
records.claim_supported: Publisher abstract advocates narrowing the management research-practice gap.
records.limitations: Full text blocked; abstract snippet inspected, not a full critical appraisal.

records.title: OECD Guidelines on Measuring Trust
records.claim_supported: Publisher record identifies guidance for collecting and interpreting trust data.
records.limitations: Full substantive sections not reviewed; neither supports nor refutes validity of TVM.

records.title: Updated OECD Guidelines on Measuring Trust and Trust Drivers in Public Institutions
records.claim_supported: Updated guidance concerns national statistics on trust in public institutions and builds on 2017 guidance.
records.limitations: Institutional rather than interpersonal scope; not an automatic replacement for all interpersonal guidance and not TVM validation.

records.title: Supabase Row Level Security documentation
records.claim_supported: Grants determine permitted operations and RLS expressions determine visible rows; a client filter is not authorization.
records.limitations: Deployed TVM grants/policies not inspected; local SQL is not proof of live exposure.

records.title: Map judgments are situated perceptions
records.claim: TVM has no validated psychometric interpretation in the inspected records; inbound ratings remain one respondent's inference. This is a scope boundary, not evidence that trust is unmeasurable.
records.validation_needed: See research agenda and linked requirements; no efficacy claim.

records.title: Visualization may surface useful relational expectations
records.claim: Direct TVM evidence needed; general design-science reasoning does not establish cognitive-load reduction or intervention efficacy.
records.validation_needed: See research agenda and linked requirements; no efficacy claim.

records.title: Guided inquiry may improve actionability
records.claim: Compare visualization alone and facilitated prompts; record negative outcomes and contextual differences.
records.validation_needed: See research agenda and linked requirements; no efficacy claim.

records.title: Confidence in inference may support assumption testing
records.claim: Investigate interpretation and burden using cognitive interviews; not a validated confidence scale.
records.validation_needed: See research agenda and linked requirements; no efficacy claim.

records.title: Secure development and access checks are necessary
records.claim: High confidence in relevance of authorization checks, not current assurance of TVM security.
records.validation_needed: See research agenda and linked requirements; no efficacy claim.

records.title: The intervention includes software, facilitator and context
records.claim: Provisional adaptation from the MRC context/programme-theory approach; transfer to TVM and useful outcomes require direct evaluation.
records.validation_needed: See research agenda and linked requirements; no efficacy claim.

records.title: Authoritative agent context and traceability
records.acceptance: New contributors find the current charter, decisions, requirements, evidence scope and next task; checker passes registry and change-manifest checks; historical pause/AI-first banners are superseded.
records.validation_plan: python3 scripts/check-governance.py --base BASE --head HEAD; negative fixtures reject broken references and unlinked material changes.

records.title: Preserve canonical app and prototype provenance
records.acceptance: Keep v1 and its deployment path; preserve all eight pinned reference SHAs. Parent sync must neither advance prototypes nor overwrite canonical AGENTS.md.
records.validation_plan: Companion parent convergence tests; inspect no changed gitlinks and no remote archive/deletion operations.

records.title: Inquiry language and directional meaning
records.acceptance: UI, facilitator instructions and report label ratings as current perceptions; inbound wording says believe; unconsidered is not zero or low. Existing conflict-specific question is retained until wording study.
records.validation_plan: Review all client-facing strings; cognitive interviews RQ-0001; browser directional and unscored scenarios.

records.title: Evidence, interpretation and uncertainty capture
records.acceptance: Optional structured observation, interpretation, confidence in inference and alternatives are separate; unknown remains distinct from low confidence. No requirement to add more scoring dimensions.
records.validation_plan: Round-trip migration/load/export tests and pilot burden interview.

records.title: Behavioral experiment and desired shift
records.acceptance: Capture desired shift, hypothesis, action, expected result, surprising result, intended date and optional outcome; allow one to three selected relationships without coercion.
records.validation_plan: Persistence/export tests; follow-up EXP-0001 assesses action usefulness and unintended effects.

records.title: Safe local persistence and schema migration
records.acceptance: Reload and resume retain data; clear/start fresh erase it; malformed payloads fail safely; errors are visible; opening welcome/share never silently erases current/saved data; supported old maps migrate with no inferred new fields.
records.validation_plan: Browser reload/resume/start-fresh/quota/blocked-storage tests plus nested schema fixtures.

records.title: Private optional sharing and revocation
records.acceptance: No direct anonymous table enumeration; retrieval enforces authorization independent of client filters; secure capability generation and rate limiting; explicit consent; revocation/delete by authorized owner; synthetic staging tests.
records.validation_plan: Allow/deny tests for anon/auth roles including unfiltered SELECT, wrong capability, expired/revoked map, forged expiry and oversize insert. Human security review before any live migration.

records.title: Retention, deletion and privacy disclosure
records.acceptance: Distinguish access expiry from physical deletion and backup retention; document and test retention/deletion; no client data in repo or unnecessary telemetry; use pseudonyms by default for pilot.
records.validation_plan: Synthetic delete/expiry tests, network/log review, disclosure review and data-handling inventory.

records.title: Dependency remediation and release assurance
records.acceptance: Audit on lockfile and release build; remediate applicable critical/high runtime findings; document reachability and time-bound disposition of remaining issues; never use npm audit fix --force blindly.
records.validation_plan: npm audit including production-only view; build/lint/regression tests at resulting commit; SBOM and reviewable remediation record.

records.title: Accessible mapping and exports
records.acceptance: Target WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard scoring, modal focus/escape/restore, readable directional labels, non-color cues, mobile/reflow and accessible textual alternatives. Export faithfully distinguishes reported observations from interpretations.
records.validation_plan: Manual keyboard/screen-reader/reflow checks and automated accessibility tests; requirement-level evidence for applicable WCAG criteria.

records.title: Developmental pilot and consent
records.acceptance: Document recruitment, consent, service/research distinction, pilot data controls, analysis, negative cases and safety stop rules before use. Evaluate feasibility/actionability rather than claim efficacy.
records.validation_plan: Signed protocol authorization and prerequisite release gates; report session-level and participant-level data without treating repeated sessions as independent participants.

records.title: Evidence freshness and applicability
records.acceptance: Sources have verified scope, supported content, limits, edition, review date and trigger; blocked sources stay partial; material conclusions cite relevant sources or are hypotheses.
records.validation_plan: Registry/checker validation and human appraisal; recheck volatile sources at release, not merely on a calendar.

records.title: Unintended disclosure through shared-session access
records.treatment: Inspect deployed grants/RLS with owner using synthetic data; prevent anonymous enumeration; do not use sensitive pilot maps before authorization tests pass.
